title: Closure review checklist
description: The closure review: a second reader checks a closed record against the ten items in the documentation standards, logs a finding for every box left open, and records the outcome.

recordReviewed.description: Record reviewed (event report / alert report / pattern-close record), and its author

checklist.description: Tick a box only when the record meets it as written.

theDecisionHeaderIsComplete.x-assured-checkbox: The decision header is complete: verdict on both axes in the fixed vocabulary, the Escalation decision with who made it and when, priority with its matrix cell or override, and a bottom line a non-technical reader can follow

everyFactualClaimCitesIts.x-assured-checkbox: Every factual claim cites its source: a query and time range, a log record ID, or an artifact hash

confidenceIsLabeledPerClaim.x-assured-checkbox: Confidence is labeled per claim on the shared rubric, not once for the case

negativeFindingsAreRecordedWith.x-assured-checkbox: Negative findings are recorded with what was examined, not just "nothing found"

theTimelineIsInUtc.x-assured-checkbox: The timeline is in UTC with the date, and each entry has an actor, rationale, and outcome

everyOpenQuestionFromThe.x-assured-checkbox: Every open question from the handoff packet is resolved in section 2 or 3, or carried into section 8

everyIndicatorAndObservableHas.x-assured-checkbox: Every indicator and observable has a disposition (malicious, suspicious, or known-good)

sharedAndTrainingVersionsAre.x-assured-checkbox: Shared and training versions are sanitized, and people are written about neutrally

materialAiUseIsDeclared.x-assured-checkbox: Material AI use is declared, "none" included

benignAndAuthorizedClosesState.x-assured-checkbox: Benign and authorized closes state their reopen conditions

outcome.description: Outcome (accept / request clarification / flag as a training case)

clarification.description: Clarification requested from (author), due by (UTC), and resolved at (UTC)

trainingCaseNote.description: Training-case note (what the case teaches, in one line; optional)
